body:
This is the only risky part of the PR. The order of these members determines how we sort the instances. This change is very beneficial because it allows us to copy over the surface info with a single `mov` instruction instead of doing 5 `mov` instructions plus a bunch of bit shifting and masking. However, it changes the sort order which may have unintended side effects. 

I kept the order as similar as possible while still keeping things logically organized. 

Ultimately, I don't think this sorting is very effective anyway. It was very important to sort like this in the per-Vulkan era where every API call resulted in expensive validation in the driver. Nowadays API calls are cheap so the benefit is greatly reduced. In fact, it may be faster not to sort the draw calls at all (or to do a very rough parellel sort)
